summary: Piedmont Realty Trust's operating partnership priced and issued $230 million of 2.875% Exchangeable Senior Notes due February 1, 2031, including $30 million of option notes, under a September 17, 2026 indenture guaranteed by the parent and sold to initial purchasers. Interest pays semi-annually from February 1, 2027; notes are senior unsecured obligations. Exchange is contingent before November 1, 2030, then at holder election, settleable in cash or cash-plus-stock. This is a routine convertible-style financing, not a special situation; watch the equity-linked overhang and any exchange-price reset terms.
